item.text:
**Bottom Line**
Mixed, leaning negative. I found some evidence of public-interest mineral policy, technocratic staffing, and support for oversight bodies. But the strongest 2024 signals are opaque procurement, patronage-shaped government formation, and term-limit anxiety, which together suggest only partial separation between state action and personal/coalitional interests.

**Accepted Claims**
- [Congo election commission overspent, awarded opaque contracts-report](https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Congo-election-commission-overspent-awarded-opaque-contracts-report-45741663/) | Reuters | 2024-01-15 | CENI failed to account for about $400 million and used opaque procurement before the election. That is direct evidence of weak separation between a core state function and clean public-finance management. | IDs: 7B.3, 7B.2
- [DR Congo names new government after months of delay](https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/DR-Congo-names-new-government-after-months-of-delay-46846207/) | Reuters | 2024-05-29 | Cabinet formation was delayed by internal jostling for posts, and the final cabinet was larger than expected despite pressure to cut costs. This supports a patronage reading rather than a clean firewall between office and private/coalitional interest. | IDs: 7B.3
- [Congo president Tshisekedi draws criticism over constitutional reform plans](https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/congo-president-tshisekedi-draws-criticism-over-constitutional-reform-plans-2024-10-24/) | Reuters | 2024-10-24 | Tshisekedi’s constitutional-reform push raised fears it could remove term limits and enable a third term. That is the clearest sign that state institutions may have been bent toward his own political survival. | IDs: 7B.3, 7B.1
- [DR Congo presses Apple over minerals supply chain, lawyers say](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/dr-congo-presses-apple-over-minerals-supply-chain-lawyers-say-3397337) | Reuters | 2024-04-25 | Congo sought more information from Apple about possible conflict minerals in its supply chain. This is a plausible pro-public-interest use of state power in a sector vulnerable to rent capture, rather than obvious private enrichment. | IDs: 7B.3
- [Congo and Chinese partners sign reviewed Sicomines copper and cobalt joint venture agreement](https://uk.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Congo-and-Chinese-partners-sign-reviewed-Sicomines-copper-and-cobalt-joint-venture-agreement-46201204/) | Reuters | 2024-03-14 | Tshisekedi backed a revised Sicomines deal that increased infrastructure investment and improved Congo’s terms. This is one of the better pieces of evidence that mineral policy was being used for state revenue rather than private or family gain. | IDs: 7B.3
- [IMF and DR Congo reach agreement on final review of loan deal](https://theprint.in/india/imf-and-dr-congo-reach-agreement-on-final-review-of-loan-deal/2076600/) | Reuters | 2024-05-09 | The IMF said Congo still had to manage funds from the revised mining deal properly and noted progress was positive but slow. This supports a limited reading of external fiscal discipline and some effort to keep mineral revenues inside the public budget. | IDs: 7B.3
- [Le Chef de l’État a assisté à l’ouverture de la session extraordinaire du conseil supérieur de la Cour des comptes](https://www.presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/le_chef_de_l_etat_a_assiste_a_louverture_de_la_session_extraordinaire_du_conseil_superieur_de_la_cour_des_comptes) | Présidence RDC | 2024-10-07 | The Court of Accounts publicly credited Tshisekedi’s support for anti-corruption control and oversight functions. This is positive evidence that he was at least willing to strengthen institutions that restrain favoritism and misuse of office. | IDs: 7B.3
- [DR Congo president appoints country’s first female prime minister](https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/dr-congo-president-appoints-countrys-first-female-prime-minister-2024-04-01/) | Reuters | 2024-04-01 | Appointing Judith Suminwa, a technocratic planning minister, is limited positive evidence against pure patronage staffing. It does not prove clean separation from interests, but it does show some willingness to elevate competence. | IDs: 7B.3

**Search Gap**
- I did not find strong 2024 reporting directly tying Tshisekedi himself or his immediate family to a named private business, shareholding, or explicit kickback scheme.
- Most negative evidence is indirect: opaque election procurement, cabinet patronage, entrenchment fears, and executive control over sensitive security and economic decisions.
- So the best-supported judgment is not “proven family-business capture,” but “partial separation at best, with substantial patronage and self-entrenchment risk.”
